datasets.name: QASPER
datasets.used: document ids, question ids and question text
datasets.selection: seeded sample, profiling from the validation split, test from the test split without rows 0-9 (manifests/chat_with_pdf/SELECTION.md)

datasets.name: arXiv e-prints (PDF)
datasets.license: the arXiv license chosen by each article's authors (not recorded per file)
datasets.used: unmodified PDFs, fetched by prepare_data.py and checked against the manifest sha256

local_state.vector_db: Chroma, a new temporary directory per script run (app behavior)
local_state.metadata_db: embedchain SQLite (chat history), one fresh file per document session

adaptations.what: headless driver: streamlit.testing.v1.AppTest runs the unmodified chat_pdf.py; key, upload and question go through the app's own widgets (FileUploader.set_value uses Streamlit's upload path)
API key typed into the app's key field from OPENAI_API_KEY

adaptations.why: embedchain's documented opt-out of its PostHog analytics; not a workflow call
keeps embedchain's config out of the home directory and separate per client

adaptations.what: EMBEDCHAIN_DB_URI = a fresh SQLite file per document session, set before each script run
adaptations.why: embedchain keeps chat history in one process-wide metadata DB; a fresh file is the app's first launch, so sessions do not see each other's history

adaptations.what: TMPDIR = <client workdir>/tmp; a session's temporary entries are deleted when it ends (untimed)
adaptations.why: the app's mkdtemp vector DBs and upload temp files stay in the client's directory; disk space

adaptations.what: chromadb SharedSystemClient.clear_system_cache() and gc after each session (untimed)
adaptations.why: the app opens a new Chroma client per rerun and never closes it
